title: State carry-over with Persist State off and a startState override
note: Persist State off: today every turn starts from the Start state.

turns.question: I would like to open a business account for my shop.
Please restart the intake for my second shop.
turns.note: startState override (enabled for the Start node in the API config)

turns.question: How long does the approval take?

reply.content: Intake ({turn}): I have recorded the shop details and marked the request as qualified.
Follow-up ({turn}): our onboarding team will call you within two business days.

expectedAfter.F03: State always carries over (TS11): count goes 1,2,3,4 and stage stays qualified, so turns 2 and 4 route to Follow Up instead of Intake Agent.
